title: Non-euclidean virtual reality
summary: Henry Segerman and collaborators demonstrate virtual reality experiences in non-Euclidean spaces, including hyperbolic and mixed hyperbolic-Euclidean geometry. The browser-based demos let viewers move through these spaces and show how strange the geometry feels from inside.
why: Cited as the go-to example of hyperbolic geometry made intuitive through VR.

quote.text: reminds me of the demonstration of hyperbolic geometry in VR by Henry Segerman
